segments.name: Vacation Ownership
segments.description: Develops, markets, and sells vacation ownership interests to individual consumers, provides consumer financing, and provides property management services at resorts.
segments.evidence: Vacation Ownership — develops, markets, and sells vacation ownership interests ("VOIs") to individual consumers, provides consumer financing in connection with the sale of VOIs, and provides property management services at resorts.

segments.name: Travel and Membership
segments.description: Operates travel businesses including vacation exchange brands, travel technology platforms, travel memberships, and direct-to-consumer rentals for members and partners.
segments.evidence: Travel and Membership — operates a variety of travel businesses, including vacation exchange brands, travel technology platforms, travel memberships, and direct-to-consumer rentals.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay for vacation ownership interests, financing, and maintenance fees, while members and business partners pay fees for exchange and travel club services.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, we generated 46% of our revenues from the sale of vacation ownership interests, 40% from our fee-for-service revenue streams, 11% from our consumer financing revenue stream, and 3% from other ancillary revenue streams.

changes.text: In 2021, the company acquired the Travel + Leisure brand and was renamed from Wyndham Destinations, Inc. to Travel + Leisure Co.
changes.evidence: In connection with this acquisition, on February 17, 2021, Wyndham Destinations, Inc. was renamed Travel + Leisure Co. and trades on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNL.
